## What public-channel failure does this change address?

Link the issue or reproducible fixture.

## Boundary check

- [ ] This remains delivery evidence, not publishing, vulnerability scanning, automatic repair, or full CLI regression.
- [ ] A deterministic fixture fails before the implementation change and passes after it.
- [ ] `npm run test:release` passes.
- [ ] `dist/` was rebuilt and committed.
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, have compatible licenses and updated notices.
